title: Dev : Treatments, double profile change entries
body:
When my automations trigger a profile % change, they are noted twice in the treatments' profile tab. 

Usually, both lines have the same time but sometimes they differ by 1 minute...

![Screenshot_20251211_215504_AAPS.jpg](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a55ce79f-c832-48b5-92b0-81245dae2968)

Can't see why they are noted 2 times 🤔

comments.body: That's expected. One is EPS , another PS
